sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to build upon the long relationship between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Demo Gießerei GmbH. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal and are willing to commit to a 24-month contract to provide mutual planning security.

Our offer stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

As a family-run foundry, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms to manage our operations effectively. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.30 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. Our main cost drivers remain SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
